dispositions.method: Round two of 1798. The sweep check of 24 and 25 November 2026 (X-THIN-SWEEP; outputs/story_discovery_1779/sweep_check_25nov.md) read every passage of the 1798 pages shared word for word by 4 or more papers that no counted opening of round one explains, looked each up in the year's lists and counted it by its own opening words against every page of the year in both transcriptions. It found two items printed by every paper that survives for their weeks, which round one's lists did not name; asked, the owner chose on 25 November 2026 to admit them as the rule reads. Every printing was checked against its page scan by AI reviewers (scan_batches/round2.json, SCAN_PROTOCOL.md; verdicts in scan_verdicts/round2*.json).
dispositions.selection_rule: As in round one (Y-THIN as amended, B1): an item printed by every newspaper that survives for its weeks is admitted. Both items are printed by all 4 papers of their weeks; they are one affair (the Spanish posts on the Mississippi), and each is admitted by its own count, as the rule's first part reads.
